next-spotter-role.label: Official Spotter / Teamtailor full-stack listing
next-spotter-role.text: current public page. Live role names Pakistan among six hiring countries and says fully remote. React/MUI and Python/Django are the core stack; REST APIs, non-trivial logic, query/caching performance and independent communication are required. GCP/Redis/Docker, mobile and AI coding assistants are bonuses. Resume precedes assessment; the advertised $100 is conditional assessment compensation, not salary. HTTP 200 also captured locally.

next-spotter-jobs.label: Official Spotter current openings
next-spotter-jobs.text: current public page. The matching full-stack role is among 18 current openings; company careers site links to spotter.ai. Separate React Native search result is absent from the current list and was not treated as a new active lead.

next-painter-careers.label: Official Painter Marketing Pros careers list
next-painter-careers.text: Web retrieval succeeded this turn; a later retry timed out. Retrieved public careers page lists nine openings: account management, appointment setting, CRM, SEO, QA and operations. The full-stack role is absent. It offers an open application, which is not confirmation that this engineering vacancy is active. Main company homepage links to this careers subdomain. Later direct HTTP fetch returned 403.

next-painter-board.label: Himalayas listing, secondary evidence
next-painter-board.text: current public page. Board advertises Pakistan/Philippines, React/Node alternatives, PostgreSQL and cloud/microservices skills, US Eastern 9am–6pm Monday–Friday. Degree is preferred. Board salary cadence/amount is suspect and unverified; do not treat $1K/year as an agreed term. Apply redirects to Himalayas sign-up.

next-chasi-careers.label: Official Chasi careers page
next-chasi-careers.text: current public page. Live company careers page embeds jobs.gem.com/chasi-ai and retains a legacy Dover careers link. Both raw pages returned HTTP 200, but the job list depends on JavaScript; this research did not manipulate a browser.

next-chasi-legacy.label: Employer Dover role, indexed snapshot
next-chasi-legacy.text: Search index reports crawl four months ago. Indexed exact Senior Software Engineer role says Remote (International), React/TypeScript, at least two years, backend/API knowledge and a completed related degree. Current direct retrieval is a JavaScript shell. Treat the indexed listing as historical role evidence, not present hiring confirmation.

next-chasi-yc.label: Chasi employer listing on Y Combinator
next-chasi-yc.text: current public page. Different current Founding Engineer listing is San Francisco in person, six days weekly, with travel. It does not confirm or replace the older remote Senior Software Engineer vacancy.

next-emetlab-careers.label: Official Emetlab careers page, indexed content
next-emetlab-careers.text: Official-domain search index, crawl age two weeks; live verification unavailable. Official indexed careers page lists Junior and Senior Software Engineer among four positions and says it hires globally. It publishes careers@emetlab.com for open applications with CV, introduction and desired role. Direct live fetch returned HTTP 522; web open repeatedly timed out. Role-level requirements and current country terms were not independently retrievable.
